name: Are there diversion programs for felony charges?

mainEntity.name: Are there diversion programs for felony charges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some felony charges may qualify for diversion programs involving treatment, education, or community service, allowing dismissal upon successful completion, especially for first-time or drug-related offenses.calmatters​
